t: What to say over something newly yours
a: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ مِنْ خَيْرِهَا وَخَيْرِ مَا جُبِلَتْ عَلَيْهِ وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّهَا وَشَرِّ مَا جُبِلَتْ عَلَيْهِ
p: Allāhumma innī asʾaluka min khayrihā wa khayri mā jubilat ʿalayh, wa aʿūdhu bika min sharrihā wa sharri mā jubilat ʿalayh
m: O Allah, I ask You for the good in her and the good of what she was made with, and I seek refuge in You from the evil in her and the evil of what she was made with.
